docs/changelog-utilities.md documents changelog subpath export usage

summary: Created docs/configuration.md — full reference for MenuConfig (all properties including usageLine), Command, SetupComponent, PreflightCheck, and HelpVariant interfaces with annotated examples.

Created docs/changelog-utilities.md — documents the @mistralys/cli-menu/changelog sub-path export: ChangelogEntry type, readChangelogVersion(), extractChangelogEntry(), readPackageVersion(), readPyprojectVersion(), and multi-source usage pattern.
Updated README.md MenuConfig table to add the missing usageLine? property row.
Added §resolveVersion(config) section to README.md API reference (documentation-forward from code review).

Updated printHelp() rendering behaviour list: removed the outdated Phase B hardening note that promised usageLine support (now implemented), replaced it with accurate description of current fallback behaviour.

comments.note: docs/configuration.md — cross-links to the API reference in README.md would be helpful for discoverability; users landing in docs/ won't automatically know the README contains function signatures. Low priority since the README is the canonical API reference.

README.md §resolveVersion(config): addressed documentation-forward item from code review. Section placed immediately before §Help rendering since resolveVersion is an internal dependency of printHelp().
README.md §printHelp(): removed stale Phase B hardening note about usageLine — the feature was delivered in WP-002. The rendering behaviour list now accurately describes the ?? fallback.
